parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-cluster-plugin-info --lang zh --plugin-name alihips --cluster-ids 902e428f6cc6679685d65fc818030000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
